note: P4384 (Pro 31:6) — give strong drink to the perishing, wine to those in bitter distress.

dims.v: anguish — the bitter distress that wine may ease
the bitterness of soul of those in distress, to whom wine may bring relief — the deep anguish of the suffering and perishing, for whom drink is a mercy where for a ruler it is a peril
welded to the anguished soul it describes

mar (bitter) — 'and wine to those in BITTER distress' (31:6); the anguish of the suffering, for whom wine is a comfort. What corrupts the judge (31:4-5) may mercifully ease the dying and the broken-hearted — drink judged by its use.
suffering — the anguished soul given wine for relief
the distress of soul of the perishing and heavy-hearted — the suffering spirit for whom strong drink is offered as a mercy, to help them forget their misery for a while
welded to the bitter anguish it feels

nephesh (soul) — 'to those in bitter DISTRESS' (31:6, 'bitter of soul'); the anguished spirit of the suffering, for whom wine is a comfort. The same drink that endangers the ruler mercifully eases the perishing (cf Job 3:20).
